description: Search the Internet Archive library (40M+ items) using the Advanced Search (Solr) API. Filter by media type (texts, audio, movies, software, image, etc.), collection, creator, date range, and language. Sort by downloads (the default), date, title, or random. Supports pagination via page/rows. Returns identifiers, titles, creators (the first 10, with creator_count when a record lists more), media types, dates, download counts, collections (without fav- favorites lists), total_found, and current page/rows for pagination context. Use ia_get_item with a returned identifier to get full metadata and file manifests.

collection.description: Filter to items within a specific collection identifier, e.g. "gutenberg" or "librivoxaudio".

creator.description: Filter by creator name, e.g. "Charles Dickens".

date_from.description: Start of date range filter in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "1900-01-01".

date_to.description: End of date range filter in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "1999-12-31".

language.description: Filter by language code or name, e.g. "eng" or "English".

mediatype.description: Filter by media type: texts, movies, audio, software, image, data, web, collection, etree (live concert recordings), or account. Case-insensitive; text, book, and books mean texts, movie, video, and videos mean movies, images means image, and collections means collection. Any other value is rejected.

page.description: Page number (1-indexed). Combine with rows for pagination. Advanced Search serves only the first 10,000 results, so page × rows ≤ 10,000 (page 50 at 200 rows, page 200 at 50).

query.description: Solr query string. Supports field prefixes such as title:"war and peace", creator:dickens, subject:history. Plain keywords search all fields. Put a URL in quotes. At most 2,047 characters, a limit the filters below also count toward.

rows.description: Number of results per page (default 50). One call returns at most 200: on page 1 a larger value (up to 10,000) is served as 200 with a notice naming the next page; on later pages a value above 200 is rejected.

sort.description: Sort order in Solr format: a sortable field followed by asc or desc, e.g. "downloads desc", "date asc", "publicdate desc", "titleSorter asc", or "random". Default: "downloads desc". Advanced Search has no relevance sort. Except under random, results tied under the sort are ordered by identifier, so consecutive pages neither repeat nor skip an item.

name: ia_search_items

cap.description: The per-call cap applied to rows (200).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mediatype`: mediatype is not an Internet Archive media type or one of its recognized spellings. `page_limit_exceeded`: page × rows exceeds 10,000, the last result Advanced Search serves. `rows_over_cap`: rows is above 200 on a page after the first. `invalid_query`: Advanced Search rejected the query syntax, an unquoted URL, the query length, or the sort field. `search_unavailable`: Advanced Search failed, rate-limited the request, returned an unreadable response, timed out, or could not be reached (network error). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

collection.description: Collection(s) this item belongs to, in upstream order. Per-account favorites lists (fav-<account>) are left out; omitted when nothing else remains.

creator.description: Creator or author name(s) — the first 10 when the record lists more.

creator_count.description: Total creators on the record, present only when creator lists the first 10; ia_get_item returns them all.

date.description: Publication or upload date; a few records carry a list, relayed as received.

identifier.description: Internet Archive item identifier. Use with ia_get_item.

title.description: Item title; a few records carry a list, relayed as received.

notice.description: Guidance when the page came back empty — nothing matched (naming the mediatype filter applied, if any), or the requested page is past the last page of results — or when rows was capped, naming the rows and page that continue.

rows.description: Rows per page applied: the requested rows, or 200 when a larger value was capped.

total_found.description: Total number of matching items across all pages.

truncated.description: True when rows above 200 was served at 200 and more results remain.

title: Search Internet Archive Items
